query: I am selling my car to a friend in the same city. There is no loan on it. Which forms do we need?
gold_answer: Two forms: the seller (transferor) reports the sale in Form 29 and the buyer (transferee) applies for transfer of ownership in Form 30. Both go to the registering authority (in West Bengal, the motor vehicle office where the vehicle is registered) with the original RC, insurance, PUC and the other supporting documents. Form 35 is only needed if a loan (hypothecation) is recorded on the RC.
